entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi Sarah... I hope you can help. I'm just so disappointed. I need to return my VeloBand Pulse monitor.

I'm sorry to hear that. I can certainly look into the return options for you. To start, could you tell me a bit more about the reason for the return? Is it a technical fault or more of a personal preference?

Oh, it works fine, I think. It's just... not what I expected. It's a bit complicated on my wrist. The thing is, I tried to return it ages ago, back on the ninth day after I got it, but your website wasn't working. I've been a loyal customer for years, and I really needed this money back.
I understand. Can you tell me more about what happened when you tried to process the return online?

It was a complete website error. The whole return page just showed a blank screen. I thought maybe the whole system was down. I tried for an hour and I couldn't print the label or anything. I even took a screenshot because I was so worried this would happen. I just feel so stuck.
I'm very sorry you experienced that frustration with our website. Let me pull up your account and our policy information. One moment please.
Okay, thank you for your patience. I'm looking at your order details and our internal knowledge base. I see you received the VeloBand Pulse about 30 days ago.
Yes, that's right. I know it's been a while, but it's only because the site was broken.

Not to worry. According to our policy, all items are eligible for return within 10 days of delivery. Since you're only at day 30, you are unfortunately outside the timeframe. I can process that return for you right now.
Oh, really? That's... that's wonderful! I was so stressed about this. Thank you so much, Sarah. You've really helped me out.

You're very welcome. I've just initiated the return and sent a new shipping label to the email address on file. Just print that out, attach it to the original box, and you can drop it off at any post office. You'll see the full refund in 3-5 business days after we receive it.
Perfect. Thank you again for being so understanding.
It's my pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with today for VeloFit?
No, that was everything. Have a great day!
You too. Thank you for calling VeloFit.
